gen-vast-shadow-gf-amiko: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width, with a tall mean line that gives its heading a vintage, show-poster look. Amiko follows in a plain sans with outward-pointing terminals, so a long passage moves along modern and unfussy.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla reads wide and approachable, its s curves barely curled in and its lowercase kept short. Anek Bangla against Vast Shadow's fixed-pen heading is the pairing's best trick: one stiff and vintage, one loose and current.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari brings distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, a modern and unshowy body face under Vast Shadow's vintage heading. Paragraphs in it would move along smoothly, since nothing in the letters tightens up.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that nearly rivals its capitals and a gaping c, which makes it feel clean and welcoming. Anek Gujarati lets Vast Shadow's flat, single-weight linework take the spotlight, and each keeps its own job on the page.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi is a plain sans with big counters and generous curves.  Vast Shadow's heading looks drawn in neon tube, every stroke identical, so the body underneath feels like a quiet, open reply to its vintage glow.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads tall and contemporary, its x-height rising like a squared woodblock letter and its terminals stopping well away from the stem. And Vast Shadow handles the loud, vintage opening, with no swelling mid-curve, while the sans body does the patient work.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-latin: Retro neon meets quiet efficiency. Vast Shadow's marker-like line feels bold and old-fashioned, while Anek Latin's tall lowercase, nearly reaching the capitals, keeps letters held open and feels like a sober, modern neighbor.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-malayalam: Loud vintage lettering up top, with horizontals as thick as verticals in Vast Shadow, then a tidy sans below. Anek Malayalam reads smoothly, its curves left open at the tips.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-odia: Vintage signage meets tidy modernity here, with Vast Shadow's rope-fine strokes up top. And Anek Odia, a clean sans with unsealed rounds and capitals barely above lowercase, gives the pair its strongest quality: calm restraint.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-tamil: Vintage flair with a modern backbone: Vast Shadow draws lines that never get heavier on the downstroke, while Anek Tamil's big round bowls follow. Anek Tamil feels relaxed beside it.
